LESSON: PROHIBITIONS IN ISLAM • INTOXICANTS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.2: Prohibitions in Islam • Intoxicants
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Prohibitions in Islam • Intoxicants, part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why does Islam prohibit the use of intoxicants? 2. What are the effects of intoxicants on the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss and list intoxicants rampant in the community,

2. research on the negative effects of intoxicants and make short notes,

3. search and watch age- appropriate videos on the effects of intoxicants,

4. make posters on the effects of intoxicants,

5. story-tell/dramatise effects of intoxicants,

6. brainstorm on ways of curbing the use of intoxicants and make posters. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss and list intoxicants rampant in the community,
2. research on the negative effects of intoxicants and make short notes,
3. search and watch age- appropriate videos on the effects of intoxicants,
4. make posters on the effects of intoxicants,
5. story-tell/dramatise effects of intoxicants,
6. brainstorm on ways of curbing the use of intoxicants and make posters. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Prohibitions in Islam • Intoxicants together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: interacting with digital technology is attained as learners search for videos on the effects of intoxicants.

• Communication and Collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills enhanced as learners discuss and list

the intoxicants rampant in the community

• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of making connections is developed through creation of posters, story-telling and

dramatisation.

Values:
Respect: enhanced as learners respect each other’s views while engaging in group discussion

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health issues: Alcohol and substance abuse avoidance heightened as learners discuss the effects of intoxicants and brainstorm

on ways of curbing use.
